description: The complete interface implemented by ob, the OpenBindings reference tool. One unbound contract describing everything ob does: creating, inspecting, editing, validating, comparing, and invoking OpenBindings interfaces, plus context storage and environment management. This document carries no bindings or sources; it is the single source of truth from which the per-surface realizations (CLI via usage, server via OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/MCP) are derived, so they cannot drift. An operation that realizes a published OpenBindings interface is keyed by that interface's operation name (e.g. openbindings.key-value-store.set), so satisfaction needs no alias; ob's own operations are keyed under the ob namespace (e.g. ob.pullSource). Aliases appear only where one operation satisfies more than one published interface, as listFormats does.
name: ob

openbindings.ob.codegen.description: Generate a typed invoker for an interface in a target language (TypeScript or Go). The output is an invoker over the cardinality-agnostic handle, not a cardinality-specific client.

openbindings.ob.compareInterfaces.description: Structurally compare two interfaces (or one interface against what its sources produce) and report the differences per operation and metadata field, including cross-source drift.

openbindings.ob.conform.description: Scaffold a target interface so it conforms to a reference interface: add the operations the reference requires and reconcile mismatches, returning the updated target and a report of each change. With dryRun, reports the changes without applying them.

openbindings.ob.describe.description: Return identity and metadata about ob: name, version, description, homepage, repository, maintainer.

openbindings.ob.getContext.description: Get the stored context for a key. Returns the unified context payload (credentials, headers, cookies, environment, metadata in a single opaque map), or null when no context matches. Lookup on URL keys is hierarchical, like invocation-time matching: the exact key wins, then the store walks up the URL path to the most specific stored prefix. Exact keys behave as a plain key-value get, so the key-value-store alias holds.

openbindings.ob.getDelegateRequirements.description: Return the published interface a delegate must satisfy to provide a capability (invoke → binding-invoker, synthesize → interface-synthesizer, inspect → source-inspector), so a prospective delegate can be checked against the exact contract (e.g. via reportCompatibility). The interfaces are immutable documents bundled with this ob release.

openbindings.ob.inspectSource.description: Inspect a binding source artifact and report the bindable targets it contains, before any interface is created. Lets tooling show a user what an artifact offers.

openbindings.ob.invokeBinding.description: Invoke a resolved binding via a typed bidirectional I/O frame stream (the binding-invoker frame protocol). The caller streams BindingInvokerInputFrame messages (one `open` carrying the BindingInvocationInput, zero or more `input`, one `close`); the service streams BindingInvokerOutputFrame messages back (zero or more `output`/`input_closed`, then exactly one terminal `complete` or `error`). One shape covers unary, server-streaming, client-streaming, and bidirectional bindings; cardinality is observed by how the caller drives the frames. Missing runtime context fails with a terminal CONTEXT_REQUIRED error carrying ContextRequiredDetails, before any output and any side effect.

openbindings.ob.listContexts.description: List non-secret metadata summaries for all stored contexts; never returns secret values. Completes the context surface with listing and inspection: the generic key-value-store substrate these contexts are stored under (satisfied by getContext/setContext/removeContext) standardizes only opaque get/set/delete, so this management view is ob's own.

openbindings.ob.listDelegates.description: List every registered delegate — the self-delegate included — with the operations each carried when last resolved, the capabilities and formats ob derived for routing, and its selection preferences.

openbindings.ob.listFormats.description: List the binding formats this instance can handle. One operation satisfies the listFormats slot of every interface that has one, since the answer is the same regardless of which capability is asking.

openbindings.ob.mergeInterfaces.description: Selectively apply changes from one interface (or from the target's own sources) into another, and return the merged interface alongside a report of what was applied and skipped.

openbindings.ob.prepareBinding.description: Preflight a binding: report the context it would require before invocation, without invoking it or causing side effects. Returns ContextRequiredDetails the runtime can resolve proactively, or null when requirements cannot be determined statically. Advisory; invokeBinding's reactive CONTEXT_REQUIRED error is authoritative. When context is supplied, reports only the requirements still unsatisfied by it.

openbindings.ob.removeContext.description: Remove the stored context for a key. Deleting an absent key succeeds.

openbindings.ob.reportCompatibility.description: Report whether a candidate interface conforms to a target interface, as an ob-comparison-report/v1 document: paired operations with directional schema verdicts and findings, a summary verdict, coverage, and category counts. A report, not a binary verdict. The target rides the report's left side, the candidate its right.

openbindings.ob.reportEnvironmentStatus.description: Report a snapshot of the active OpenBindings environment (the .openbindings/ directory): whether it is local or global, its path, the number of delegates it holds, and the number of contexts in the user's context store (contexts are user-scoped, not per-environment).

openbindings.ob.reportInterfaceStatus.description: Report an interface's status against its sources: per-source sync state (in-sync, tracked, what a pull would change) and the source-owned vs hand-authored breakdown of its operations and bindings. Read-only — distinct from pullSource (which re-derives and writes) and from compareInterfaces with fromSources (which reports raw differences).

openbindings.ob.resolveInterface.description: Resolve an OpenBindings interface from a URL or host. Performs well-known discovery, follows redirects, and synthesizes an OBI from a raw binding spec (e.g. an OpenAPI document) when the target is not already an OBI. Returns the interface and metadata about how it was resolved.

openbindings.ob.setContext.description: Create or replace the context for a key. The supplied value fully replaces any existing context (full replacement, not partial update).

openbindings.ob.synthesizeInterface.description: Synthesize an OpenBindings interface, optionally from binding source artifacts. Given one or more sources (e.g. an OpenAPI spec, a CLI usage spec), extracts operations, schemas, sources, and bindings into the new OBI; with no sources, produces an empty interface to author by hand.

openbindings.ob.validateInterface.description: Validate an OpenBindings interface document against the specification. Reports whether it is valid, the declared spec version, and any problems. A document declaring a spec version newer than the tool supports is refused in every mode (OBI-T-04); strict mode additionally rejects unknown (non-x-) fields.

operation.description: The operation's key or any existing identifier.

aliases.description: Satisfaction aliases — other interfaces' operation keys this operation also answers to (OBI-T-12).

idempotent.description: Whether the new operation is idempotent.

input.description: JSON Schema for the new operation's input.

output.description: JSON Schema for the new operation's output.

force.description: Overwrite an existing binding for this operation and source.

inputTransform.description: Inline JSONata transforming operation input to binding input.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

outputTransform.description: Inline JSONata transforming binding output to operation output.

transformStub.description: Scaffold identity transform stub(s) on shape mismatch.

operationKey.description: Suggested operation key for this target.

ref.description: Reference within the source identifying this target.

BindingContext.description: Opaque runtime context for invocation, typically sourced from a context store. Well-known credential fields: bearerToken, apiKey, basic (username/password), accessToken/refreshToken/expiresAt for OAuth. Well-known transport fields: headers/cookies/environment (string-valued objects) and metadata. Implementations and callers MAY add fields; drivers SHOULD ignore fields they don't recognize.

BindingInvocationInput.description: Initial payload carried by the open frame: identifies the binding to invoke and provides context.

BindingInvokerInputFrame.description: One frame from the caller into invokeBinding. The caller streams: exactly one `open` first (carrying the BindingInvocationInput), then zero or more `input` frames, then exactly one `close`.

oneOf.description: Open the invocation. MUST be the first frame on the input stream.
oneOf.title: open

oneOf.description: Write one input value to the underlying binding. The value's schema is the underlying operation's, not this contract's.

value.description: One input value, opaque at this layer.

oneOf.title: input

oneOf.description: Caller signals no more input frames will be sent. Idempotent.
oneOf.title: close

BindingInvokerOutputFrame.description: One frame from the service back to the caller. Zero or more non-terminal frames (`output`, `input_closed`) followed by exactly one terminal frame (`complete` or `error`).

oneOf.description: One output value from the underlying binding. Opaque at this layer.

value.description: One output value, opaque at this layer.

oneOf.title: output

oneOf.description: The binding has closed the input side from its end. Subsequent caller input frames are ignored. Outputs may still flow.
oneOf.title: input_closed

oneOf.description: Terminal: the binding completed normally. MUST be the last frame.
oneOf.title: complete

oneOf.description: Terminal: the binding failed. MUST be the last frame. Carries a structured InvocationError.
oneOf.title: error

language.description: Target language for the generated invoker.

package.description: Go package name (Go only; default derived from the interface name).

fromSources.description: Compare the baseline against what its binding sources produce.

only.description: Scope to a specific source key (requires fromSources).

ComparisonInputDescriptor.description: Provenance of one compared document: where it came from and its canonical content hash.

source.description: Locator kind (e.g. file, http, exec); empty for inline documents.

CompatibilityReport.description: An ob-comparison-report/v1 document. The target interface rides the report's left side, the candidate its right; operations are paired by key+alias resolution (OBI-T-12) and judged directionally. A report, not a binary verdict: the summary verdict is compatible, incompatible, or indeterminate. Reserved section arrays (schemas, metadata, sources, bindings, transforms, security) accompany operations.

inputs.description: Provenance descriptors for the two compared documents.

operations.description: Per-operation deltas: pairing status (paired, only_left, only_right), directional input/output schema verdicts, and findings.

profile.description: Schema comparison profile and hash (e.g. OB-2020-12@local).

counts.description: Finding counts keyed by finding kind.

suppressed.description: Findings suppressed by suppression rules, with the rule that matched.

ConformAction.description: A single change conform made or would make to the target.

action.description: scaffold (add a missing operation), replace (update a drifted one), skip, or compatible (already conforms).

operation.description: The operation key the change concerns.

ConformInput.description: conform input: `interface` is the reference contract whose operations `target` must satisfy; `target` is the interface scaffolded to conform, returned modified as `interface` in the result.

dryRun.description: Report the changes without applying them.

ConformResult.description: The conformed target document plus a report of each change made or proposed.

interfaceName.description: Display name of the reference interface being conformed to.

modified.description: Whether the target was changed (false under dryRun or when already conformant).

Context.description: Opaque per-target context payload: credentials, session state, headers, cookies, environment, metadata, or any other invoker-managed state. Well-known fields include bearerToken, apiKey, basic, headers, cookies, environment, metadata.

ContextRequiredDetails.description: The details payload of a CONTEXT_REQUIRED error, and the return shape of prepareBinding. Enumerates the context the invoker needs. `alternatives` are disjunctive (satisfy ANY one); the requirements within an alternative are conjunctive (satisfy ALL). This OR-of-AND shape captures semantics such as 'OAuth2 OR (apiKey AND clientCert)'.

target.description: The target the binding addresses; the runtime derives a storage key from it.

ContextRequirement.description: One prerequisite that must be satisfied before invocation, resolved into context. `type` names the requirement family (e.g. auth.bearer, auth.oauth2, auth.basic, auth.apiKey, approval.user, config.value); remaining fields are type-specific. A runtime dispatches each requirement to a resolver registered for its type.

durable.description: Whether resolved context MAY be cached under the challenge key and reused (true; e.g. credentials), or MUST be satisfied freshly each time (false; e.g. a one-shot approval). Defaults to true.

ContextSummary.description: Non-secret metadata about a stored context entry. Never includes secret values.

loadError.description: Set if the entry could not be parsed.

url.description: Context store key (normalized API origin or other stable identifier).

DelegateCapability.description: One of ob's three format-handling needs, mapping to the published interface a delegate satisfies for it: invoke (binding-invoker), synthesize (interface-synthesizer), inspect (source-inspector). A capability is ob's shorthand for the operation it delegates; a delegate offers whichever subset it satisfies.

description.description: Human-readable description of the format, when the delegate provides one.

format.description: Format token the delegate handles (e.g. grpc, openapi@3.1).

location.description: Delegate location: the exec: or http(s) URL of the delegate's OpenBindings interface.

DelegateSummary.description: A registered delegate: its identity, the snapshot of what it carries, ob's derived routing data, and its selection preferences.

builtin.description: True for ob's own native handling — the self-delegate.

capabilities.description: Which of ob's format capabilities the delegate satisfies, checked by conformance at registration.

contentHash.description: Digest of the delegate's interface document as last resolved (sha256: over its RFC 8785 canonical form). Pins the snapshot; opaque — compare for equality, don't recompute.

formats.description: The formats the delegate reported handling when last resolved.

location.description: The reference the delegate is registered under (exec: or http(s) URL). The self-delegate's location is "ob".

name.description: Display name: the delegate OBI's name, or one derived from its location.

operationPreferences.description: Per-operation preference overrides, keyed by operation identifier. The override replaces the delegate-level preference when resolving that operation.

operations.description: Every operation identifier the delegate answers to — the keys and aliases its interface declared when last resolved. A snapshot: re-registering the location refreshes it.

preference.description: Delegate-level selection preference — the default for every operation it carries. Higher is more preferred; absent is the baseline.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

DiffReport.description: The differences between two interfaces (or an interface and what its sources produce). Empty operations, metadata, and drift means they are identical.

DriftEntry.description: One operation key produced by multiple sources with differing schemas.

contextCount.description: Number of contexts in the user's context store (user-scoped, not per-environment).

delegateCount.description: Number of registered delegates in this environment.

FormatInfo.description: Information about a supported binding format.

global.description: Initialize the global environment (the openbindings directory under the user config dir) instead of a local .openbindings/ directory.

InterfaceInput.description: Wraps the interface document an operation acts on.

InterfaceStatus.description: An interface's read-only status against its sources: per-source sync state plus the source-owned vs hand-authored breakdown of its operations and bindings.

InvocationError.description: Structured error carried by an error output frame. Indicates terminal failure of the invocation.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. ERR_CANCELLED, ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED, ERR_PROTOCOL, CONTEXT_REQUIRED).

details.description: Optional structured details specific to the code. For CONTEXT_REQUIRED, a ContextRequiredDetails object.

location.description: Location of the binding source (path or URL).

operation.description: Scope the satisfaction map to a single operation.

MergeEntry.description: One operation-level change in a merge, and whether it was applied.

action.description: The merge action for this entry (e.g. add, update, conflict).

operation.description: The operation key the change concerns.

excludeOperations.description: Exclude these operations from the merge.

fromSources.description: Derive the source side from the target's own binding sources.

noBindings.description: Don't graft bindings (operations and their referenced sources still come).

noSources.description: Don't graft source entries (operations and bindings still come).

only.description: Scope to a specific source key (requires fromSources).

opsOnly.description: Graft operations only (no bindings or source entries) — the adopt-keys satisfaction strategy.

dryRun.description: Whether this was a preview run (changes reported, not applied).

openbindings.description: Target OpenBindings spec version; defaults to the tool's max tested version.

Operation.description: An operation definition as it would appear in an interface.

OperationAliasEntry.description: An operation and the interface operations it satisfies via aliases.

OperationInvocationInput.description: Initial payload carried by invokeOperation's open frame: the interface to act on and which operation (or specific binding) to invoke, plus context.

binding.description: Binding key to invoke; the operation is derived from it. Mutually exclusive with operation.

operation.description: Operation key to invoke. A binding is selected automatically.

OperationInvokerInputFrame.description: One frame from the caller into invokeOperation. Same shape as the binding-invoker input stream, with the open frame carrying an OperationInvocationInput: exactly one `open` first, then zero or more `input` frames, then exactly one `close`.

oneOf.description: Open the invocation. MUST be the first frame on the input stream.
oneOf.title: open

oneOf.description: Write one input value to the operation. Validated against the operation's input schema.
oneOf.title: input

oneOf.description: Caller signals no more input frames will be sent. Idempotent.
oneOf.title: close

OperationInvokerOutputFrame.description: One frame from invokeOperation back to the caller. Same shape as the binding-invoker output stream: zero or more `output`/`input_closed` frames, then exactly one terminal `complete` or `error`. Each output is validated against the operation's output schema.

oneOf.description: One output value from the operation.
oneOf.title: output

oneOf.description: The operation has closed the input side from its end. Subsequent caller input frames are ignored. Outputs may still flow.
oneOf.title: input_closed

oneOf.description: Terminal: the operation completed normally. MUST be the last frame.
oneOf.title: complete

oneOf.description: Terminal: the operation failed. MUST be the last frame. Carries a structured InvocationError.
oneOf.title: error

OperationListEntry.description: An operation from the interface's operations map, with its key and the bindings that realize it.

bindings.description: Keys of the binding entries that realize this operation.

key.description: The operation's key in the interface's operations map.

ProvenanceKeys.description: Keys split by provenance: source-owned (derived from a source by pullSource) vs hand-authored.

sourceKeys.description: Sources to pull; empty means all registered sources.

location.description: Delegate location: the exec: or http(s) URL of the delegate's OpenBindings interface. Also the delegate's registration identity.

preference.description: Initial delegate-level selection preference (higher = more preferred). May be changed later with setDelegatePreference.

operation.description: The operation's key or any existing identifier.

format.description: Format token to resolve to a delegate.

builtin.description: True when ob's own native handling is selected for the format.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the delegate offers for this format.

name.description: Display name of the delegate ob's routing would select.

operation.description: The operation identifier a delegate is needed for.

candidates.description: Registered delegates that carry the operation, ordered by effective preference, best first. Empty when none carry it.

operation.description: The requested operation identifier, echoed back.

address.description: Base URL or host to resolve from (e.g. https://api.example.com or localhost:8080).

resolvedUrl.description: The URL the interface document (or the source spec it was synthesized from) was ultimately fetched from.

synthesizedFrom.description: The binding-format token the interface was synthesized from (e.g. openapi@3.1) when the target was not already an OBI; absent for native OBIs.

url.description: Base URL the server is listening on.

format.description: Optional binding-source format scope for an operation entry (requires operation) — ob's extra granularity beyond the delegate-manager contract.

location.description: The reference the delegate is registered under.

operation.description: When present, the preference applies only to resolving this operation; otherwise it is the delegate-level default.

preference.description: The new preference value; higher is more preferred, 0 is the baseline, negatives rank below it. Null clears: with an operation, it removes that operation's override; without one, it resets the delegate-level preference to the baseline.

codegenName.description: The symbol name 'ob codegen' should emit for this operation. Omit (or send empty) with clear=true to remove the override.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

input.description: Replacement JSON Schema for the operation's input.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

output.description: Replacement JSON Schema for the operation's output.

own.description: Take ownership of a source-owned operation (detach) before editing.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

outputSchema.description: The real output schema to elect. Omit with clear=true to remove the election.

SoftwareIdentity.description: Identity and metadata for a piece of software.

Source.description: A binding source artifact, referenced by location or carried inline.

location.description: Location of the source (path or URL).

exhaustive.description: True if every bindable target in the source is listed.

SourceListEntry.description: A source from the interface's sources map, with its key.

key.description: The source's key in the interface's sources map.

SourcePullOutput.description: The result of a `source pull`: the resulting interface document plus the change log — the source-owned operations and bindings added, updated, or pruned, the sources pulled and skipped, and any warnings.

SourceStatus.description: Drift status of one source on an interface: what `ob source pull` would add/update/remove, plus custodial drift on hand-authored bindings whose target is gone.

custodial.description: Hand-authored bindings whose source target no longer exists.

inSync.description: Whether the source would change nothing and has no custodial drift.

tracked.description: Whether ob tracks this source via x-ob provenance metadata (written by addSource or synthesizeInterface). Untracked sources are hand-authored; pull skips them.

port.description: HTTP port when transport is http (default 8080).

url.description: Interface URL to expose as an MCP server (an OBI, a well-known discovery base, or a raw binding spec). Compose an aggregate OBI to bridge several services.

noTls.description: Skip the HTTPS listener and CA trust setup (HTTP only).

SynthesizeInterfaceSource.description: A binding source to extract operations from.

embed.description: If true, embed content inline in the output interface.

location.description: Location to fetch content from (path or URL).

name.description: Key for this source in the output interface's sources.

outputLocation.description: Location to reference in the output interface's source.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

source.description: Source key whose binding to remove.
